theory.intro: After drinking stops, the body clears alcohol at an average rate of $0.015\text{ g}/100\text{ mL}$ per hour. The **estimated time to reach zero BAC** is given by $\text{Time} = \dfrac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}$.
facts: $\text{BAC}_{\text{male}} = \dfrac{10N - 7.5H}{6.8M}$ and $\text{BAC}_{\text{female}} = \dfrac{10N - 7.5H}{5.5M}$, where $N$ is the number of standard drinks consumed, $H$ is the number of hours spent drinking and $M$ is the person's mass in kilograms.
$\text{Time (hours)} = \dfrac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}$, where $\text{BAC}$ is the blood alcohol content when drinking stops.
The constant $0.015$ is the rate of alcohol cleared from the bloodstream per hour ($0.015\text{ g}/100\text{ mL/h}$).
To convert decimal hours to hours and minutes, multiply the decimal part by $60$.
Keep full precision in the BAC and time calculations until rounding the final time as required by the question.
The calculated duration is an estimate. Individual differences affect BAC, so this formula cannot establish when a person can legally drive.
Only time reduces BAC; sleep, coffee, showers, and food do not speed up alcohol clearance.
steps: If BAC is not supplied, calculate it using the appropriate male or female formula and retain full precision
Substitute the BAC into the time formula
Convert decimal hours to hours and minutes if required, rounding only the final time as requested

development.question_text:
A person has a BAC of $0.038$.
Calculate the time, in hours and minutes (rounded to the nearest minute), for their BAC to decrease to zero.
development.solution_text:
$\text{Time} = \dfrac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}$
$= \dfrac{0.038}{0.015}$
$= 2.533\ldots\text{ hours}$
$= 2\text{ hours and } (0.533\ldots \times 60)\text{ minutes}$
$= 2\text{ hours } 32\text{ minutes}$

development.question_text:
An individual has a BAC of $0.094$.
Calculate the time, in hours and minutes (to the nearest minute), needed to reach zero BAC.
development.solution_text:
$\text{Time} = \dfrac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}$
$= \dfrac{0.094}{0.015}$
$= 6.266\ldots\text{ hours}$
$= 6\text{ hours and } (0.266\ldots \times 60)\text{ minutes}$
$= 6\text{ hours } 16\text{ minutes}$
